_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/targets/test_spell_or_ability_spell_selector.py. t_sister_of_silence is Sister of Silence: an ETB trigger with one spell_or_ability target whose spell_selector narrows the spells to instants and sorceries, every ability still legal. t_silence_snap is the same target on an instant, for the end-to-end counter. t_silence_snap_theirs adds the shared controller clause. t_quiet_sorcery is a sorcery to put on the stack.
